requirements.text: Students should be able to borrow and return books online.
Online renewals for borrowed items should be possible.
The ability to check book availability and reserve items online is essential.
Students should be able to see real-time availability of study rooms through a calendar interface.
The system should allow students to select their desired date and time for bookings.
It should provide the flexibility to adjust or cancel bookings easily.
Reminders should primarily be sent via email.
An optional text message reminder would also be beneficial.
Reminders should be sent a few days prior to the due date.
Librarians should have access to data on which books are most frequently checked out.
There should be tools that allow librarians to easily update the inventory.
Simple reports or summaries regarding popular items and borrowing trends should be available for librarians.
